import dataclasses,json,threading
import pytest,psycopg
from agent_guard.contracts.execution import ExecutionError,ToolId
from agent_guard.tools.catalog import snapshot_from_bytes
from tests.fixtures.execution import build_env,read_params,document_params,notification_params
from tests.fixtures.dbstate import fetch_counts
from test_review import observe,counters,effects

@pytest.mark.parametrize('tool',[ToolId.REQUEST_READ,ToolId.DOCUMENT_READ,ToolId.NOTIFICATION_SEND])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('entry',['execute','query'])
def test_other_tools_full_result_binding(a2,tool,entry):
 ref=a2.service.accept_invocation(a2.tree.invocation(tool_id=ToolId.REQUEST_READ.value,params=read_params()),a2.permission()).operation_id
 params=notification_params(operation_id=ref) if tool is ToolId.NOTIFICATION_SEND else (read_params() if tool is ToolId.REQUEST_READ else document_params())
 op=a2.service.accept_invocation(a2.tree.invocation(idempotency_key='more-tool',tool_id=tool.value,params=params),a2.permission()).operation_id
 v=a2.downstream.execute(service_secret=a2.secret,operation_id=op,tool_id=tool,canonical_params=params,quote=None,expected_amount_fen=0)
 obj=json.loads(v.result_bytes)
 if tool is ToolId.NOTIFICATION_SEND:obj.update(notification_id='different-effect',recipient_id='other-recipient',template_id='other-template')
 else:obj['tool_id']=ToolId.ORDER_CREATE.value
 v=dataclasses.replace(v,result_bytes=json.dumps(obj).encode())
 class Port:
  def execute(self,**kw):return v
  def query(self,**kw):return v
 env=build_env(tree=a2.tree,gateway_dsn=a2.gateway_dsn,downstream_dsn=a2.downstream_dsn,downstream=Port())
 r=env.service.run_operation(op) if entry=='execute' else env.service.reconcile(op)
 observe('r3-other-tool-result',{'tool':tool.value,'entry':entry,'status':r.status,'counters':counters(a2),'effects':effects(a2)})
 assert r.status=='UNKNOWN' and env.service.outbox_entry(op) is None

def test_formal_deadlock_regression_requires_real_terminal_progress(a2,monkeypatch):
 from tests.integration.test_execution_regressions import test_claim_and_finalize_interleaved_never_deadlock
 real=threading.Barrier;errors=[]
 class RecordedBarrier:
  def __init__(self,*args,**kw):self.inner=real(*args,**kw)
  def wait(self):
   try:return self.inner.wait()
   except threading.BrokenBarrierError:errors.append(threading.current_thread().name);raise
 monkeypatch.setattr(threading,'Barrier',RecordedBarrier)
 test_claim_and_finalize_interleaved_never_deadlock(a2,monkeypatch)
 counts=fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)
 observe('r3-formal-lock-test-efficacy',{'broken_barrier_errors':errors,'counts':counts,'effects':effects(a2)})
 assert errors==[] and counts['ag_receipt_outbox']==10 and counts['ag_ledger_events']==20

def test_notification_wrong_holder_checked_before_reservation(a2):
 ref=a2.service.accept_invocation(a2.tree.invocation(tool_id=ToolId.REQUEST_READ.value,params=read_params()),a2.permission()).operation_id
 before=fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn); cc=counters(a2)
 inv=a2.tree.invocation(tool_id=ToolId.NOTIFICATION_SEND.value,params=notification_params(operation_id=ref),holder=('wrong-client','wrong-kid'))
 with pytest.raises(ExecutionError) as ex:a2.service.accept_invocation(inv,a2.permission())
 assert ex.value.code.value=='RESOURCE_NOT_AUTHORIZED' and fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)==before and counters(a2)==cc
 observe('r3-notification-wrong-holder',{'target_exists':True,'refused_before_A1':True,'state_unchanged':True})

@pytest.mark.parametrize('mode',['reordered','wrong-layer','extra','missing-mid'])
def test_complete_chain_identity_negative(a2,mode):
 snap=a2.permission();ids=list(snap.chain_grant_ids);chain=list(snap.chain)
 if mode=='reordered':ids.reverse();chain.reverse()
 if mode=='wrong-layer':ids[1]='wrong-grant'
 if mode=='extra':ids.append('wrong-grant');chain.append(chain[-1])
 if mode=='missing-mid':del ids[1];del chain[1]
 snap=dataclasses.replace(snap,chain=tuple(chain),chain_grant_ids=tuple(ids));before=fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)
 with pytest.raises(ExecutionError) as ex:a2.service.accept_invocation(a2.tree.invocation(tool_id=ToolId.REQUEST_READ.value,params=read_params()),snap)
 assert ex.value.code.value=='CONSTRAINT_MISMATCH' and fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)==before
 observe('r3-complete-chain-identity',{'mode':mode,'state_unchanged':True})
